tooltip.scythes.blood_blender.desc: Right click in the air pulls enemy targets within 3 blocks toward you, deals damage equal to 2 basic scythe attacks, inflicts Slowness II for 4 seconds, and inflicts Bleeding II for 10 seconds. Ignores teammates, pets, and neutral mobs. If there are no nearby targets, the ability does not activate.

tooltip.scythes.blood_harvest.desc: Marks enemy players within 10 blocks for 20 seconds. Costs 100 durability and has a 60-second cooldown. Kill during the window for 16 seconds of Speed II, Strength II, and Regeneration II; fail and receive 7.5 seconds of Slowness II, Weakness II, and Blindness.

tooltip.scythes.bloody_scythe.desc: A cursed endgame scythe for relentless melee pressure: 40% bleed chance, 25% vampirism chance, a 20% chance to partially pierce defenses, and Blood Harvest for finishing marked players.
tooltip.scythes.bloody_scythe.passive.de: On hit: 40% chance to inflict Bleeding for at least 2 seconds. Bleeding deals true damage and ignores armor, Protection, and resistance. Vampirism has a 25% chance to heal 50% of actual damage dealt, with a 1-second delay between successful heals. It also has a 20% chance to ignore 50% of the target's damage mitigation.
advancement.scythes.bloody_essence.title: Morality? What's that?
tooltip.scythes.toxic_scythe.base_stats: Base stats: same damage tier and attack speed as the Bloody Scythe.
tooltip.scythes.toxic_scythe.desc: A brutal anti-armor scythe: its basic attacks corrode equipment and spread Poison II, while its orb and aura punish clustered enemies.
tooltip.scythes.toxic_scythe.passive.des: On hit: 30% chance to deal 20 durability damage to the target's entire armor set, and 25% chance to inflict Poison II for 2 seconds.
tooltip.scythes.toxic_orb.desc: Right click launches a toxic orb with a 5-second cooldown. It costs 20 durability, bursts in a 2-block radius, deals 2 armor-piercing damage, inflicts Poison II for 10 seconds, and deals 30 durability damage to the whole armor set.
tooltip.scythes.toxic_aura.desc: Activates for 10 seconds with a 60-second cooldown and costs 100 durability. Within 5 blocks it refreshes Poison II for 10 seconds, damages armor every tick, and can trigger armor-piercing damage or Nausea.

tooltip.scythes.withering_scythe.base_st: Base stats: same damage tier and attack speed as the Bloody and Toxic scythes.
tooltip.scythes.withering_scythe.desc: A necromantic endgame scythe: harvests souls from the fallen, spreads Wither II, summons wither-skeleton minions, and empowers them with a dark aura.
tooltip.scythes.withering_scythe.passive: On hit: 30% chance to inflict Wither II for 10 seconds. Killing a mob stores 1 soul; killing a player stores 12 souls.
tooltip.scythes.withering_minion.desc: Right click in the air summons a nearby wither-skeleton minion for 10 durability and 6 souls. Minions follow their owner, defend them, and vanish after 5 minutes. Shift+right click dismisses all of your minions.
tooltip.scythes.withering_aura.desc: Activates for 10 seconds with a 60-second cooldown and costs 100 durability. Within 5 blocks it refreshes Wither II for 10 seconds, while your minions within 10 blocks receive refreshed Strength II and Speed II for 3 seconds.
